[attribute-rendering-hint]
=== `@rendering-hint` Rendering Hint

Suggestions for display of the content. Rendering systems are allowed, but not required, to display as indicated.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-term-display-string,`<term-display-string>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters.| Instructions to aid in displaying (rendering) the text content of the <<element-term-display-string,Term-display String>> inside a <<element-term-display,Term-Display>>, for example “newline”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
